summary: iter159 - new 'Activate Material Site' page (/admin/activate-material-site) end-to-end verification, including the FIRST successful authenticated screenshot of this page (which was the one open item main agent could not capture this session). Backend pytest: 7/8 PASS. Frontend Playwright against the real preview URL: all UI + access-control assertions PASS. Feature works exactly as spec'd - passcode gate unlocks with 'admin', lookup of PALL-373518 returns description 'CAGE PALLET 37.0"X35.0"X18.0"', category RM, active_sites=[P1,P2,P4,P6,P7]; site dropdown lists all 8 known sites (P1,P2,P2W,P3,P4,P7,P8,P9) with '(already active)' suffix on P1/P2/P4/P7; picking a non-active site (P3) enables the submit button with correct label 'Activate PALL-373518 at P3' (NOT clicked - would be a real SAP write); negative lookup 'NONEXISTENT-MATERIAL-999' surfaces a clean red error 'No material found in SAP with ID ...' via data-testid='activate-material-site-lookup-error', no crash. Access control: limited 'user'-role account (only bom_explorer) sees NO 'Activate Material Site' nav entry, hits the SPA 'Access Denied' page on direct URL, and both /api/admin/material-sites/lookup/{id} and POST /api/admin/material-sites/activate return 403 {"detail":"Access required"}. Regression: existing /admin/create-material still loads the same passcode gate.

minor.issue: During my test window SAP returned 'Locking object not possible; object locked by UNEECOPSTEAM (RAY INTERNATIONAL)' for PALL-373518. This is a transient live-SAP lock (the app's own OData business user was holding a write lock on the material at that moment) - NOT a code bug. The endpoint correctly surfaces SAP's exact reason string in both `planning_logistics` and `valuation` fields (mapped to red X in the UI). The idempotent 'already active P1 -> ok' safe-noop assertion was therefore not verifiable in this window; retest is safe once no other SAP session is editing PALL-373518. Backend logic itself is fine - lookup, permission gate, error propagation all correct.

action_items: None required. Feature is ready. Optional retest of the idempotent P1 no-op path in a quieter SAP window (the material was live-locked by UNEECOPSTEAM during my run - the endpoint surfaced SAP's exact reason correctly).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:6785/6801 - permission check `{stock_transfer, admin_activate_material_site} & set(allowed_pages)` correctly grants access to users who have EITHER page permission, plus super_admin/admin bypass. Clean.

ActivateMaterialSitePage.js is a clean mirror of CreateMaterialPage.js: same passcode-gate pattern, same warning banner, all interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes (passcode-input/submit, lookup-form/button, id-input, card, description, active-sites, select-trigger, option-<site>, submit-button, lookup-error, result-<key>). Well structured.
Dropdown UX is clean - '(already active)' inline suffix in the option label immediately tells the user which choices are no-ops; server-side idempotency then makes accidentally picking one safe.

Result panel uses two clearly-separated rows (Planning/Logistics/Availability Confirmation vs Valuation) with green check / red X + SAP's exact reason string on failure - matches the documented spec that Valuation can independently fail with 'Account det. group is missing' and should never be silently hidden.
